brief:
Political analyst Farhan Alqam said Israeli aggression against Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank is escalating in parallel, according to Shehab Wire. He contended the intensifying operations cannot be divorced from Israeli elections scheduled for October 27. Alqam characterized the dual offensive as inseparable from electoral politics.

The analyst framed killing and destruction as central to Netanyahu's campaign platform ahead of the vote. He argued the timing and scope of military operations reflect electoral strategy rather than isolated security responses.
